atZero.text: No Deathbed Fighting roll. The hero transforms into a Werewolf (the bestiary's stats and powers, no hero gear) at full Health and rolls Luck — the chance is the Luck stat as a percentage (Luck 0 always turns). Success: a player unit, and at 0 Health again the hero dies, no bleed-out. Failure: an enemy unit; beaten to 0 it falls in the hero's original form and bleeds out, rescuable as any downed hero. Retreat while transformed is abandonment. At battle end the hero is back to normal.
